eval: document.querySelector('.banner')?.remove(); (() => { const g = document.querySelector('.page.is-top .free-route'); if (!g) return 'no free route'; const b = document.querySelector('.page.is-top .page-body'); b.scrollTop += g.getBoundingClientRect().top - 500; return 'ok ' + b.scrollTop; })()

(() => { const g = document.querySelector('.page.is-top .free-route .group'); const n = document.getElementById('navbar').getBoundingClientRect().bottom; const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.page.is-top .free-route .cell-inner')].map((e) => { const b = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return e.textContent.trim().slice(0, 12) + ' ' + Math.round(b.left) + ',' + Math.round(b.top) + ' ' + Math.round(b.width) + 'x' + Math.round(b.height); }); return { navBottom: n, groupTop: g.getBoundingClientRect().top, cells: r, focused: document.activeElement?.getAttribute('aria-label') }; })()
